name: Globe Life Inc.
business: Life and supplemental health insurance sold to middle-income US households (American Income Life, Family Heritage, direct-to-consumer).

news.title: Q2 net operating EPS $3.61 (+10%); FY26 operating EPS guide raised to $15.55–15.95; $175M buyback
Q2 recap: stock fell ~7% after the release despite the beat

pros: Consistent buybacks; ROE {roe}; SEC/DOJ probes into AIL sales practices closed without enforcement action
cons: Remaining civil/derivative litigation and agent-practice headline risk
Life premium growth only +3%; agent recruiting is the key swing factor
take: Fundamentally cheap, steady compounder; the discount reflects lingering reputation/legal risk rather than weak numbers.

metrics.summary: Globe Life Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides various life and supplemental health insurance products to lower middle- and middle-income families in the United States. It operates in three segments: Life Insurance, Supplemental Health Insurance, and Investments.
